feedback.problem:
Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}5 & 1 \\ -1 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the coordinates of the point ${C}^{′}$, the image of $C(3,0)$ under the action of $T?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the image of $C$ under the action of $T$, we first create a column-vector $x$ containing the coordinates of $C:$

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we compute the image of $x$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $Tx:$

$$
\begin{aligned}Tx & =[\begin{aligned}5 & 1 \\ -1 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}15 \\ -3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The result, $Tx,$ contains the coordinates of ${C}^{′}.$ Therefore, ${C}^{′}(15,-3).$
